description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behaviors, particularly focusing on directory and symlink merging scenarios, conflict resolution, and preservation of file states during various checkout and merge operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, takes a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link between specified directories or files.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails when executed.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
